lessons.topic: shareNow mode fails for video Reels
lessons.detail: Buffer's mode:'shareNow' for Instagram Reels causes a media container error. Instagram's API requires async video processing time before publishing.
lessons.fix: Use mode:'customScheduled' with dueAt at least 30 minutes in the future. Never use shareNow for video content.

lessons.topic: Buffer video publishing fixed — account was personal, not Professional
lessons.detail: All video Reel failures traced to @ayahguideus being a personal Instagram account. Instagram's Content Publishing API requires Professional (Business/Creator) account for video. Buffer showed 'Instagram Professional Account' but refresh revealed it was personal. Fix: switched account to Business in Instagram settings, then did Refresh Connection in Buffer Channels. Video publishing now confirmed working (PostActionSuccess).
lessons.fix: Connection refreshed 2026-05-04. Video Reels now publish via Buffer API. No more manual posting needed.

lessons.topic: H.264 High profile rejected by Instagram Reels
lessons.detail: HyperFrames default render uses H.264 High profile level 4.0, which Instagram's container API rejects with 'Unable to get media container status from Instagram: ERROR: ERROR'. Failed twice on word-for-human (10:39 PM ET 4/30 and 10:52 AM ET 5/1) before fix.
lessons.fix: ALWAYS re-encode HyperFrames MP4 output before uploading to Buffer. Use ffmpeg with: -profile:v main -level 4.0 -preset slow -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 48000
lessons.impact: Two failed publish attempts on word-for-human

lessons.topic: Font sizes too small in carousel inner slides + reel labels
lessons.detail: User feedback: inner carousel slides had 11-27px font sizes, illegible at Instagram display scale. Reels had 22-26px secondary text, also too small (Instagram displays at ~2.7x reduction).
lessons.fix: Carousel minimum body 30px, headers 50px, labels 22px. Reels minimum 36px for any readable text. Bumped all 4 scheduled posts on 5/1 — ran sed across all three reel HTML files plus targeted edits across slides.ts.

lessons.topic: Instagram carousel type must be post, not carousel
lessons.detail: Buffer rejected instagram type:carousel — valid types are post, story, reel. Carousels with multiple images use type:post.
lessons.fix: Changed metadata.instagram.type from carousel to post in scripts/post.ts

lessons.topic: BREAKING: Buffer changed assets schema — broke BOTH post.ts and post-reel.ts
lessons.detail: Buffer's CreatePostInput.assets is now [AssetInput!]! — a LIST of typed wrappers, each one { image | video | document | link }. The old object forms { videos: [{url,thumbnailUrl}] } (reels) and { images: [{url}] } (carousels) are REMOVED. Reels failed with 'Field "videos" is not defined by type "AssetInput"'. This silent break likely contributed to the late-May publishing gap. Introspected the live schema to confirm: VideoAssetInput={url!,thumbnailUrl,metadata}; ImageAssetInput={url!,thumbnailUrl,metadata}; metadata.instagram=InstagramPostMetadataInput{type:PostType!, shouldShareToFeed:Boolean!}; PostType enum includes reel,post,story,carousel.
lessons.fix: post-reel.ts: assets: [{ video: { url, thumbnailUrl } }]. post.ts: assets: imageUrls.map(url => ({ image: { url } })). Both fixed + verified scheduling live on 2026-06-01. To re-introspect later: query { __type(name:"AssetInput"){inputFields{name}} } with the Buffer bearer token.

video_specs.codec: H.264 MAIN profile, level 4.0 (NOT High — High is rejected by IG container API)
video_specs.reencode_cmd: ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -c:v libx264 -profile:v main -level 4.0 -preset slow -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 48000 -y out_ig.mp4

buffer_api.assets_shape: assets is [AssetInput!]! — a LIST of typed wrappers. Reel: [{ video: { url, thumbnailUrl } }]. Carousel: [{ image: { url } }, ...]. (Updated 2026-06-01; old { videos:[...] } / { images:[...] } object forms REMOVED by Buffer.)
buffer_api.carousel_mode: metadata.instagram = { type: 'post', shouldShareToFeed: true }; multiple image assets render as a carousel
buffer_api.share_now_for_video: DO NOT USE — causes container error; use customScheduled with dueAt >= 30min out
